name: Google Search Console by DigestSEO
tagline: Search Console analytics, indexing, sitemaps, and SEO workflows through MCP
description: Connect Cline to Google Search Console through a hosted OAuth MCP endpoint. Query clicks, impressions, CTR and position, inspect URL indexing and sitemap health, compare periods, surface SEO opportunities, and use explicit write operations when needed. The project is open source and self-hostable.

install.notes: Uses Google OAuth. Review write-capable Search Console operations before approving changes.
